_comment: CLSM Generator. AutoForm over ClsmGeneratorViewModel: load an intensity image + one lifetime map per detector (TIFF/numpy), set simulation parameters, and Generate a synthetic CLSM photon image whose per-pixel intensity and lifetime match the inputs. The image_browser shows the input maps and the reconstruction; Save writes the photon stream (.npz / .ptu / .spc / .ht3) plus an intensity TIFF.

sections.label: Intensity image
sections.description: Intensity image (TIFF or .npy/.npz); sets the per-pixel brightness.

sections.title: Lifetime map(s)
sections.description: One fluorescence-lifetime map (ns) per detector channel, matching the intensity-image shape.

sections.label: Channel width (ns)
sections.description: Micro-time channel width; the excitation period is n_micro × dt.

sections.label: τ levels
sections.description: Quantisation levels for the lifetime axis (more = finer, slower).

sections.label: Intensity levels
sections.description: Quantisation levels for the intensity axis.

buttons.label: 🧪 Generate
buttons.description: Simulate the CLSM photon image from the loaded intensity + lifetime maps.

buttons.label: 💾 Save
buttons.description: Save the generated photon stream (.npz / .ptu / .spc / .ht3) + an intensity TIFF.

sections.title: Maps
sections.description: Browse the input intensity image, the input lifetime map(s), and the reconstructed CLSM intensity.
